meta.methodology: Read cause/effect edges from torah_97_ce_edges.json (4 eitza edges). Collected all 20 nodes already assigned to packages from torah_97_packages.json. Identified 7 unique nodes across cause/effect edges; 1 already assigned (יראה in Package 1), 6 unassigned. Each unassigned node assigned to existing packages by essential nature, considering polarity and the Torah's thematic structure.

assignments.reason: Humility (anavah) is the spiritual quality that emerges when one prays with the two bechinot of Menashe and Efraim (line 9: 'וּבְוַדַּאי בָּא לִידֵי עֲנָוָה וְשִׁפְלוּת'). Its essential nature is a quality of the praying self — the self-nullification inherent in sovereign prayer. The Rebbe presents humility as the interior dimension of prayer-with-malkhut: forgetting one's greatness (Menashe) and transforming foreign thoughts (Efraim) naturally produce humility, which in turn draws yirah (= malkhut). Anavah's essential nature is thus inseparable from the prayer-sovereignty domain. It belongs in Package 1.

This compound node ('humility and lowliness') is the fuller expression of the same quality as ענוה. Line 9 uses the exact phrase 'עֲנָוָה וְשִׁפְלוּת' as the state reached through prayer with Menashe and Efraim. Its essential nature is identical to ענוה — the self-nullifying posture intrinsic to prayer-with-malkhut. Belongs in Package 1.

assignments.node_id: כשמתפלל בשתי בחינות אלו, מנשה ואפרים הנ"ל
assignments.node_text: וּכְשֶׁמִּתְפַּלֵּל בִּשְׁתֵּי בְּחִינוֹת אֵלּוּ, מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם הַנַּ"ל
assignments.reason: This composite node describes the state of 'praying with the two bechinot of Menashe and Efraim.' Its essential nature IS prayer-with-malkhut — it is the exact thing that Package 1 describes. Menashe and Efraim are already in Package 1 as the two inner postures of sovereign prayer; this node is the integrated state of prayer conducted with both. It belongs in Package 1 by direct identity with the package's core concept.

This node describes 'also praying with fear/awe.' Its essential nature is prayer-with-yirah. Since יראה is already in Package 1 (declared niqret malkhut in line 10), and תפלה is the dominant node of Package 1, a node whose essential nature is 'prayer conducted with yirah' belongs squarely in the prayer-and-kingship domain. This is a state of prayer that has attained the quality of malkhut through the chain: Menashe+Efraim → anavah → yirah → malkhut. It belongs in Package 1.

assignments.node_id: צריך לשבר המחשבות זרות על־ידי מחשבות קדושות של התפלה
assignments.node_text: צָרִיךְ לְשַׁבֵּר הַמַּחֲשָׁבוֹת זָרוֹת עַל־יְדֵי מַחֲשָׁבוֹת קְדוֹשׁוֹת שֶׁל הַתְּפִלָּה
assignments.reason: This node describes the act of breaking foreign thoughts through holy thoughts of prayer. Its essential nature is the Efraim-aspect of prayer — the second inner posture of sovereign prayer (line 7-8). Efraim is already in Package 1 as the bechina of transforming dryness into fruitfulness through holy prayer-thoughts. This node is the practical expression of that same Efraim-quality. The holy thoughts of prayer (machshavot kedoshot shel ha-tefillah) that do the breaking are themselves the substance of prayer-with-malkhut. Belongs in Package 1.

assignments.node_id: זדונות, דהינו המחשבות זרות, נעשין לו כזכיות
assignments.node_text: הַזְּדוֹנוֹת, דְּהַיְנוּ הַמַּחֲשָׁבוֹת זָרוֹת, נַעֲשִׂין לוֹ כִּזְכֻיּוֹת
assignments.reason: This node describes the result of the Efraim-quality: 'the intentional sins, i.e. the foreign thoughts, become merits for him.' Its essential nature is the transformation that IS the bechina of Efraim (line 8: 'כִּי הִפְרַנִי אֱלֹקִים בְּאֶרֶץ עָנְיִי' — fruitfulness from the land of poverty). The Rebbe declares this transformation bechina Efraim. Since Efraim is in Package 1, and this node describes the very same transformative quality of prayer, it belongs in Package 1. Its polarity is 'good' because the transformation itself is a positive achievement — the sins become merits.
